comment: * Listener for monitoring events about sliding panes.

methods.name: public void onPanelSlide(View panel, float slideOffset)
methods.comment:
* Called when a sliding pane's position changes.
         * @param panel The child view that was moved
         * @param slideOffset The new offset of this sliding pane within its range, from 0-1

methods.name: public void onPanelOpened(View panel)
methods.comment:
* Called when a sliding pane becomes slid completely open. The pane may or may not
         * be interactive at this point depending on how much of the pane is visible.
         * @param panel The child view that was slid to an open position, revealing other panes

methods.name: public void onPanelClosed(View panel)
methods.comment:
* Called when a sliding pane becomes slid completely closed. The pane is now guaranteed
         * to be interactive. It may now obscure other views in the layout.
         * @param panel The child view that was slid to a closed position

methodNames: public void onPanelSlide(View panel, float slideOffset)
